name: Death of Obsidian Butterflies
description: Conjures a cascade of razor-sharp obsidian butterflies that slash everyone in a roughly 10-yard area; defended against as a hand-to-hand attack with the caster's Perception + Occult successes.

name: Demon of the First Circle
description: Summons and binds a first-circle demon to the sorcerer's service over a night's ritual begun at sunset.

name: Emerald Countermagic
description: Dispels Terrestrial Circle sorcery; can also be used to counter a spell as it is cast.

name: Impenetrable Frost Barrier
description: Raises a barrier of intense magical cold that damages and hampers those who try to cross it.

name: Infallible Messenger
description: Sends a short spoken message to anyone the sorcerer has met, delivered by a tiny figure of Essence.

name: Invulnerable Skin of Bronze
description: Hardens the sorcerer's skin to add +6 soak against lethal damage and +12 against bashing.

name: Stormwind Rider
description: Wraps the sorcerer in a controllable dust-devil vortex that carries her at great speed and cushions falls.

name: Summon Elemental
description: Summons and binds an elemental to service; like Demon of the First Circle but castable any time and with gentler terms.

name: Sworn Brothers' Oath

cost.raw: 10 motes + 1 mote from each Exalted bound by the spell

description: Binds the Essence of two or more Exalted (of any type) into a sworn brotherhood over an hour-long ritual (one additional hour per Exalt beyond the first two); the sorcerer need not be one of the bound. The caster's Intelligence + Occult successes set the brotherhood's level, which drives three linked effects: Loyalty (a Conviction roll beating that level is needed to act to harm a sworn sibling), Devotion (a once-per-story bonus dice pool equal to the oathbond rating when aiding a sworn sibling), and Familiarity (each knows a sworn sibling's location within rating x 10 yards, or its direction on an Essence roll beyond that).

name: Wood Dragon's Claw
description: Transforms the hands into gnarled oaken claws dealing Strength + 4 lethal damage and able to block lethal attacks.

name: Blood of Boiling Oil
description: Hurls a sphere of searing Essence that boils a living victim's blood, dealing aggravated damage.

name: Demon of the Second Circle
description: Summons and binds a more powerful second-circle demon; similar to Demon of the First Circle but mightier and more dangerous.

name: Dolorous Reflection
description: A defensive nimbus of mystical energy that reflects ranged and hand-to-hand attacks back at the attacker.

name: Incomparable Body Arsenal
description: Grows the sorcerer's body into a living arsenal of blades and barbs, raising Strength and Stamina and dealing lethal damage.

name: Sapphire Countermagic
description: Dispels Celestial Circle (and lower) sorcery; can also counter a spell as it is cast.

name: Travel Without Distance
description: Instantly transports the sorcerer across any distance to a place she can clearly picture.

name: Adamant Countermagic
description: The most powerful countermagic; dispels sorcery of any circle up to and including the Solar Circle, and protects against lower-circle countermagic.

name: Demon of the Third Circle
description: Summons and binds one of the mighty third-circle demon princes; an extremely difficult and dangerous ritual.

name: Rain of Doom
description: Calls down a corrosive, venomous rain over a vast area that sears and poisons everything it touches.

name: Rune of Singular Hate
description: A single spoken word of pure malice that strips dots from every Ability, Attribute, and Virtue of its target; the sorcerer also permanently loses one dot from each of her own.

name: Hungry Creeping Shadow
description: Vomits forth a creature of liquid shadow that pursues one target in sight; it has Physical Attributes and Brawl equal to the caster's Essence and Stamina+Essence health levels, ignores kinetic damage, and clinches to crush its prey. Lasts one hour.

name: Iron Countermagic
description: Necromantic countermagic: 10 motes raises a personal shield negating hostile Shadowlands spells until the next turn's end (−2 to Physical actions while it persists); 20 motes extinguishes one Shadowlands spell within Essence×50 feet. May also oppose sorcery one circle higher.

name: Piercing the Shroud
description: A ten-minute chant (minus the caster's Occult) ends with a blade-cut in the air that tears open a rift to the Labyrinth for Essence turns. Only lets a necromancer enter — she must find her own way out.

name: Raise the Skeletal Horde
description: Jagged Essence-lightning animates nearby corpses within 100 yards as common zombies (extras): one per 5 motes (permanent), or one per 3 motes for temporary zombies that fall at scene's end. Cannot mix permanent and temporary in one casting.

name: Rune of Sweet Passing
description: An hour-long ritual paints a mortal's skin with blood-and-grave-soil glyphs that ensure she becomes a ghost upon death and alert the necromancer the instant she dies. Creates ghosts only; no control over them. No effect on Exalted or magical beings.

name: Shade Prison Amulet
description: Enchants a piece of bone jewelry to trap one hungry ghost it touches, holding it so long as the talisman is intact; breaking the prison frees the ghost (destroyed if broken by daylight). The Labyrinth version, Bauble of the Captive Soul, catches any ghost for 15 motes.

name: Soul Brand
description: Tattoos an unExalted mortal with a permanent rune granting the protection of a Ghost-Warding Glyph; removing it burns the mortal for the necromancer's Essence in lethal dice. Vanishes harmlessly if the bearer ever Exalts.

name: Summon Ghost
description: An hour-long night/Underworld ritual (needs the ghost's name or a piece of her corpse) tears a portal for 10 motes; each extra 5 motes weakens the ghost by a die. An opposed Willpower+Essence contest binds her to a year-and-a-day of service, or she escapes for a year.

name: Walking War Machine
description: Animates a pre-built undead siege engine (extended Intelligence+Craft (Necrosurgery) to construct): touching it and investing 5 motes per assembly success sets it serving its master. Spine-chain statistics on Exalted p300.

name: Exquisite Undead Aide
description: Raises a single capable servant instead of a horde: a common zombie whose non-Appearance Attributes are at least 2, with Intelligence+Occult in Ability dots (none above the caster's own). Never decays, can speak in clipped phrases, and has full health levels.

name: Hundred Shade Breath
description: Exhales a blue fog that coalesces into hungry ghosts (extras), one per 2 motes, over the next turn. Useless by day (sunlight burns them to ash); survivors dissolve back into the caster at scene's end, freeing 2 committed motes per ghost lost.

name: Ivory Razor Forest
description: A shockwave of Essence raises dense spines of bone (max height Essence yards) over (Charisma+Occult)×10 square yards of any shape, inflicting unblockable 8L (dodge only) to all within and to anything hurled against them. The spikes last for Essence days.

name: Reaping the Fallen
description: Flares the caster's anima to full and, for the rest of the scene, grants 1 mote for every sentient being that dies within a league (up to her maximum). The Void version, Blood from the Slaughter (35 motes), instead regenerates a health level per kill.

name: Spiteful Passing
description: A dying necromancer's final blast: after a turn concentrating, he expires as searing light, dealing everyone within Stamina yards his Essence in lethal dice plus one per remaining mote, bypassing armor (natural soak only). All plants within range wither; his corpse crumbles to dust.

name: Stealing the Gathered Breath
description: Inhales the life energy of every sentient being within Essence×5 yards, inflicting one lethal die (Stamina soak only) on each; every level actually dealt restores 1 mote to the necromancer.

name: Striking Spectre Lash
description: Grows a whip of solidified darkness with Speed/Accuracy/Defense equal to Essence, reach four times that, and Strength+Essence base damage that can grapple and kill at range. Reflexively spending 2 motes on a hit forces an Essence roll or the mortal victim drops dead.

name: Abyssal Aegis
description: Until next sunrise, grants bashing and lethal soak equal to permanent Essence and negates any magic designed to deal extra damage or trauma to Abyssals, Deathlords, or Underworld denizens — the bonus effect vanishes, though the base attack still lands.

name: Anguished Shade Harvest
description: Pacing a boundary on foot from sunset to before midnight consecrates that land to the Underworld: black clouds shroud it, and any mortal who dies violently there afterward rises at dusk as an uncontrolled hungry ghost (extra).

name: Blood Monsoon
description: A geyser of the caster's blood builds over an hour into a mile-high cloud covering Essence miles in radius, then rains gore for Stamina hours — killing plants and small animals, sickening others (hourly Stamina+Endurance check), and drawing malevolent creatures for miles.

name: Dimming of the Light
description: A sunset-to-midnight ritual transforms a willing Solar into an Abyssal: she renounces her god, Caste Mark, Charms, and name, and at midnight her anima is swallowed by shadow. She gains matching Abyssal Charms and caste (Dawn→Dusk, etc.) and is thereafter a deathknight.

name: Inauspicious Citadel
description: After sacrificing at least 100 mortals into a pit dug in a shadowland and bleeding a health level into it, the earth falls away to the Labyrinth and a unique defensible fortress of obsidian and black basalt grinds up, its lowest chapel opening onto the dead gods below.

name: Lord of the Dead
description: For a full day the caster's Caste Mark glows red, letting her command any ghost, walking dead, or creature of death of lower permanent Essence, and barring any such creature from attacking her. No power over Abyssal Exalted or Deathlords.

name: Poisoning the Well
description: Fasting at a Demesne's heart for days equal to its rating dooms it to lose a rating point each month until, at zero, it shifts to an Abyssal aspect and slowly regains strength. Only Adamant Countermagic (at double cost) or an Incarna can arrest the decay.

name: Automaton Override Protocol
description: Seizes control of animated creatures, soulless intelligences and minor machine spirits (golems, zombies, automata, First Age devices) for one scene, overriding their programming. 5 motes takes one automaton; 15 motes takes (Essence x 2) automata or devices in a 10-yard radius. No effect on natural creatures, elementals, or machine spirits of Essence 3+. Countered by Emerald Countermagic, Essence Draining Defense, or an Alchemical whose permanent Essence exceeds the weaver's by 2+. Target: one nearby automaton, or all automata in a 30-foot radius. Minimum Clarity 3.

name: Binding Filament System
description: Wraps the target instantly in extraordinarily tough silvery filaments (also known as Her Glistening Silvery Strands). Breaking free is a Strength + Athletics feat of strength totalling 10, but doing so makes the strands act as garrotes, inflicting soakable lethal damage equal to the weaver's Essence. Target: one person. Duration: indefinite. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Crystal Lotus of Repose
description: Identical to the sorcery spell Sleep of Stony Safety (Savant and Sorcerer p.117), except the protective containment is a crystal resembling a lotus flower. Minimum Clarity 2.

name: Docility Assurance Field
description: Binds one individual in a mesh of luminous filaments that does not impair movement but injures them whenever they spend Essence — the weaver fixes the type at weaving: one bashing level per mote spent, or one lethal level per 2 motes. This damage is soaked only with the target's Essence rating; committed Essence and non-Essence activity are unaffected. Cannot target a being of greater Essence than the weaver. Duration: one scene or one hour, whichever is longer. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Driving the Shadow Machine
description: Conjures a silent floating pocket of roiling shadow — a tenebrapede — that the weaver and companions ride, carrying 200 lbs of cargo/passengers per point of the weaver's Essence. Flies at 200 mph (~600 yards/turn), 25 health levels, soak 25L/35B, 90% hard cover; only one attack may be made against it or its occupants unless matched in flight. Target: weaver. Duration: (Essence x 4) hours, or until it reaches its destination, lands, or is dispelled. Minimum Clarity 2.

name: Elsewhere-Evoking Asana
description: From a seated meditative posture the weaver manifests a sphere of cold, airless, aphotic void of radius (Essence x 5) feet. It snuffs all fire, suffocates air-breathers, cuts visibility to heavy-snow-at-night, inflicts bonfire-level cold damage, and has no gravity; items entering lose all momentum. The weaver floats serenely at the center, immune to all effects but the visibility penalty, and regains Essence as if meditating. Breaking the posture ends it instantly. Target: area of effect. Duration: the longer of one hour or one scene. Minimum Clarity 5.

name: Entropy Manipulation Protocol
description: Knocks all automata within (Essence x 10) yards offline: gremlins, golems, zombies and the like take the weaver's Essence in bashing damage and fall inert until the next scene, when they resume (often confused). Does not shut down warstriders/powered armor but deadens unshielded limbs — Artifact ••• armor takes -2 mobility, each further dot reduces it by 1 (Artifact ••••• unaffected). Target: all automata within range. Duration: one scene. Minimum Clarity 4.

name: Essence Reallocation Protocol
description: A reflexive counter (like Emerald Countermagic) that cancels Terrestrial Circle Sorcery, Man-Machine Protocols, and Shadowlands Circle Necromancy, absorbing the cancelled spell's Essence into the weaver's reservoir; excess above maximum is harmlessly vented as sparks. Target: special. Duration: instant. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Lightning Elemental Concatenation Protocol
description: Identical to the sorcery spell Lightning Spider known to Creation's sorcerers; it is suspected Autochthon himself gave that spell to the Exalted. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: The Maker's Basic Defense Array
description: Surrounds the weaver with hundreds of whirling polished metal spheres acting as armor: effective hardness 5 and +10L/10B soak. Intercepted non-magical-material weapons risk shattering (Storyteller rolls 1d: normal weapon shatters on 7 or less, exceptional on 5 or less; perfect weapons immune), and even undamaged weapons need a Dexterity + Melee roll (difficulty 2) to keep hold. Unarmed attackers suffer 10 dice of soakable bashing damage. Target: weaver. Duration: 12 hours. Minimum Clarity 3.

name: The Maker's Instantaneous Forge
description: Raises a golem shell from the ground and binds an Autochthonian elemental into it to serve the weaver, with Traits/appearance by element (engine/glass/magnet/oil/smudge/steel golem) and two element-unique Charms that no foreign learner can acquire. Serves for (Essence) weeks before merging back into the Maker; the weaver may have as many active at once as points of Essence. Target: one conjured automaton. Duration: (Essence) weeks. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Optimized Component Integration Protocol
description: The weaver and all willing participants become perfectly cooperative on one shared task (usually an extended action): each benefiting member gains one die per additional member of the group, up to (Wits + Essence) individuals. Ends when the task is accomplished. Target: the weaver and all willing targets in a 10-foot radius. Duration: the longer of one hour or one scene. Minimum Clarity 5.

name: Phlogiston Web
description: Expels an enormous net of phlogiston (sticky solid fire) covering 100 square feet per point of permanent Essence in a shape the weaver chooses. The net inflicts (Essence + 4) lethal health levels every turn. Cutting it needs a magical-material weapon and four successes on Strength + Melee, or a Strength + Athletics roll (difficulty 5) to break by force. Fire-immune characters take no damage. Target: area of effect. Duration: (Essence) turns. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Plague of Bronze Snakes

cost.raw: As Plague of Bronze Snakes (Savant & Sorcerer)

description: Identical to the spell Plague of Bronze Snakes (Savant and Sorcerer p.112), except the snakes wriggle out of the Alchemical weaver's own body at the protocol's commencement. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Probability Degradation Matrix
description: Turns fate against the weaver's enemies: familiars rated under 3 flee, and hostile spirits of Essence under 2 must pass a Valor roll or flee for two turns per point of the weaver's Essence. For the duration, every afflicted enemy suffers +1 to all target numbers, 10s count as a single success, and each 1 negates a success. No effect on the weaver's allies. Target: enemies in a 10-yard radius. Duration: one hour or one scene, whichever is longer. Minimum Clarity 5.

name: Sonic Hammer Vocalization
description: A devastating shriek that shakes bone, rattles teeth, makes hearing impossible, and deals glass/crystal objects 10 levels of bashing damage. In all other regards identical to the spell Thunder Wolf's Howl (Savant & Sorcerer p.122). Target: area of effect. Duration: (Essence) turns. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Soul Archiving Protocol
description: Recaptures a loose ghost into a soulgem via a contested Willpower + Essence roll (5 motes per extra die). Souls so captured cannot escape until the death of their next incarnation. A classified protocol; learning it requires Backing 4 or more with the Luminors. Target: ghost. Duration: permanent. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Static Essence Absorption Protocol
description: Drains (Essence x 2) motes from one Essence-gathering/storing device or item with committed Essence (Hearthstone, Essence gem, attuned weapon) into the weaver's tanks. Drained Hearthstones stop for (6 - Manse rating) hours; gems must be recharged and weapons reattuned. Cannot drain from an Essence-user's own pools. Target: one item. Duration: instant. Minimum Clarity 2.

name: Summon Autochthonian Elemental
description: Exactly like the Terrestrial Circle spell Summon Elemental (Exalted p.219), but calls only the elementals common to Autochthonia — crystal, lightning, metal, oil, smoke and steam. Target: elemental. Duration: up to one month. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Summon Machine Spirit
description: Very similar to Summon Elemental (Exalted p.219) but captures a machine spirit chosen by any criteria via the same Willpower contest. Larger spirits, disliking multitasking, often send subroutine spirits to serve in their stead. Target: one machine spirit. Duration: instant. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Theoplastic Engineering Protocol
description: Reshapes the local techno-organic landscape at the weaver's gesture — sealing tunnels, raising room, pulling veins to the surface — moving 500 cubic feet of material per turn. In Creation it sculpts up to (Essence x 100) square feet of stone (trenches, mounds, tunnels, bridges) and can raise ore veins up to (Essence x 100) feet deep. Immuring an enemy is slow (5 turns) and resistable (Strength + Athletics, difficulty 2, +1 per shaping turn). Target: terrain. Duration: one scene. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Vat Surrogate Reweaving Technique
description: If the weaver has Charms on retainer at the Vats (Vats Background), this instantly swaps one currently installed Charm for one stored there, bypassing the usual need to return to the Vats. Target: one Alchemical Exalt. Duration: instant. Minimum Clarity 4.

name: Vision Transmitting Protocol
description: Spits forth a head-sized crystal dodecahedron into which the weaver speaks a message; functions exactly like the Terrestrial spell Infallible Messenger (Exalted p.218) except the recipient sees the speaker's image and background events in the crystal as well as hearing him. Target: one creature. Duration: one message. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Auspicious Reformatting Mudra
description: Reweaves an automaton or machine's pattern to a new destiny — mending, reactivating, or transforming it (gremlin to custodian, warstrider to airship, or into inert parts). Automatic if the weaver's Essence >= the target's, else a contested Essence roll. Can reconfigure a machine spirit of up to half the weaver's Essence (round up) into an Artifact of half the weaver's Essence (round up) or a familiar rated at the weaver's Essence; equal-power artifact conversions need (Artifact rating) successes on Intelligence + Lore. At Essence 7 the weaver alters multiple targets in line of sight (+5 motes each), but only their programming/behavior, and none may exceed permanent Essence 3. Target: one automaton. Duration: permanent. Minimum Clarity 6.

name: Destiny-Optimizing Meditation
description: Communing with the Core of the Machine God, the weaver prognosticates the optimal path to his goal and enacts it in perfect mechanized grace, adding (Essence) successes to every roll for the duration. Target: weaver. Duration: (Essence) turns. Minimum Clarity 6.

name: Essence Matrix Inversion Procedure
description: Prepared up to a day ahead, this makes the weaver's Essence matrix highly reflective: all incoming protocols, sorcery spells and necromancy effects (except Solar Circle Sorcery and Void Circle Necromancy) targeting her or any area including her are turned back on their source, as are Essence weapon effects (implosion bows, Essence cannons). Target: weaver. Duration: one day. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Executive Filature Protocol
description: Grasping the strands of a being's pattern, the weaver unravels it Trait by Trait (she must stay within (Essence) feet and do nothing else, or it terminates). After a first turn of dawning panic, the target loses one Attribute dot per turn from highest down; once all Attributes reach 1 she loses health levels, growing transparent, and at the last level fades from the pattern entirely, her soulgem dropping empty. Unwoven Traits do not return on their own, though the weaver may reweave them at 5 motes per dot within one day. Weavers usually obtain this from the Divine Ministers or design weavers. Target: one individual. Duration: varies. Minimum Clarity 6.

name: Homuncular Drone Deployment

cost.raw: 5 motes and one health level per drone (committed)

description: Separates the weaver's forearms into hovering attack drones (down one health level per drone until they refuse). Drones use the weaver's Traits, gain the weaver's Essence in Brawl, keep brawling-aid benefits, and hover at twice her movement rate; each can take three health levels, and a destroyed drone leaves the weaver permanently down one health level until the limb is replaced at the Vats or healed as aggravated damage. Target: weaver. Duration: one scene. Minimum Clarity 2.

name: Incarnation of Bestial Malice
description: The weaver metamorphoses into a living nightmare war form comparable to a Lunar's, combining aspects of any beasts or plants; the mechanical nature vanishes. Grants hardness 10 and +10 soak vs bashing and lethal, +2 Strength and +2 Stamina (even above 5), bestial weapons as Artifact •• magical-material weapons (no material bonus) with +3 speed/+1 accuracy and Strength + 6 lethal (Strength + 8 in a clinch), and reach out to (Essence) yards. Incompatible with armor and weapons. For 5 extra motes the form also gains wings, flying at three times land speed. Target: weaver. Duration: (Essence) hours. Minimum Clarity 2 (Maximum Clarity 7).

name: Instantaneous Transfer Protocol
description: Identical to the spell Travel Without Distance (Exalted p.221), except the Alchemical sinks into the substance of the Great Maker in one place and emerges from the ground at the destination the next instant. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Machine-Soul Essence Baffle
description: From an asana at the center of the area, the weaver attunes a spherical space to his own Essence flow to the exclusion of all others, making it proof against sorcery and protocols. In all other respects equivalent to Mercury's Deliverance (Savant and Sorcerer p.131). Target: area of effect. Duration: five shifts. Minimum Clarity 2.

name: The Maker's Advanced Defense Array
description: Like the Maker's Basic Defense Array but with a sphere of whirling adamant shuriken: effective hardness 10 and +20L/20B soak. Weapons that strike it shatter — non-magical-material on 1-9, magical-material only on 1 (Storyteller rolls 1d) — and even undamaged weapons need a Dexterity + Melee roll (difficulty 3) to keep hold. Unarmed Brawl/Martial Arts attackers suffer 10 dice of soakable lethal damage, and any attacker taking more than two health levels loses the attacking limb. Target: weaver. Duration: 12 hours. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Maser Palm Technique
description: Equivalent to the spell Blood of Boiling Oil (Exalted p.220), except the target's blood simply boils and denatures in the veins rather than becoming oil. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Passenger Hosting Protocol
description: Interweaves the weaver's pattern with up to (half permanent Essence, round up) willing individuals, who occupy the same space and are telepathically linked; only the weaver may act. Passengers' Strength, Stamina, Soak and Resistance stack onto the weaver's, and all damage is split evenly among weaver and passengers. A spirit passenger must first Materialize; a hosting weaver cannot be possessed. Target: the weaver and passenger(s). Duration: one day. Minimum Clarity 3.

name: Pattern Suspension Protocol
description: The Alchemical version of Eternal Crystalline Encasement (Savant and Sorcerer p.127): the weaver wraps the target object in a scintillating cocoon of spun diamond fiber, then spins a pearl of gem-stuff whose touch ends the protocol and resumes pattern function. Minimum Clarity 0.

name: Radiant Matrix Transmutation
description: A wave of dynamic order radiates 10 feet per turn, transmuting solids and liquids to faceted elemental crystal (existing crystal/adamant unaffected; artifacts resist for (Artifact rating) turns, N/A items for 10, Maker-forged items are immune). Caught creatures take the weaver's Essence in aggravated damage per turn and become crystal statues if Incapacitated; healing requires cutting the crystal from living flesh first. Heals blight zones and reclaims shadowlands within the Maker. Target: (Essence x 10)-foot radius. Duration: permanent. Minimum Clarity 6.

name: Transcendent Consciousness Protocol
description: Expands all five senses to fill a 60-yard-diameter sphere, sensing through solid objects (and through the Maker's veins) as if touching, examining and closely hearing everything, with full processing of the data. The weaver cannot be surprised, detects even invisible intruders by weight/air/heartbeat/scent, and gains her Essence rating as automatic successes on Perception rolls within range. Target: weaver. Duration: one scene. Minimum Clarity 4.

name: Transcendent Pattern-Weaving Protocol
description: Spins order out of the Wyld: each hour of prayer and mudra formats reality in a 20-yard radius (weavable for as many hours as the weaver has Stamina), dealing Fair Folk in the area the weaver's permanent Essence in aggravated damage. It strangles every raksha within (Essence) miles (doubled in the Deep Wyld). Targeting a raksha noble directly forces a contested Willpower + Essence roll; on a loss he is reformatted into a torpid Jadeborn soul in an egg of jade. Target: nearby Wyld areas. Duration: permanent. Minimum Clarity 10.
